message.content:
# Translation of Li Bai's "静夜思" (Quiet Night Thoughts)

## Step 1: Chinese to English

**Translation:**
> Bright moonlight before my bed,
> I suspect it is frost on the ground.
> I raise my head to gaze at the bright moon,
>
